rule: At least 200 per preset; do not require all 528 solely for numeric floor. Missing/unreviewed subjects remain UNKNOWN; retain catalog numeric priority.

rows.subject: fight camera and creature scale
rows.defect: The oversized ally often fills half the combat view and hides the trainer opponent or player while some frames clip into creature geometry
rows.review_disposition: Existing fight scans reported foliage, trainer occlusion and attack-indicator clutter; two earlier blind readers did not confirm half-view/ally occlusion or clipping. Three fresh blind reviews of 14 retained High/Medium states all found the ally below half, no Galewisp hidden and no visible creature intersection. Partial trainer overlap is disputed; foliage, magenta effects and small HUD/log text recur. V3 state-15 High/Medium files are marked non-live and show the battle-lost screen; mapping them to catalog sighting warden_aldis-r15 is unverified, so they do not fill that sighting. Keep blocked; exact samples and other opponents/body sizes do not establish the full defect or a fix.
rows.required_next_evidence: Matched before/candidate views for all listed sightings with independent blind categorical review. Warden Aldis states 01/02/03/05 have reviewed High/Medium baseline only; exact South Bridge Grunt states 01/02/03/05/r05 and Warden Aldis r15 receipts were not found in retained manifests, and no candidate pairs are present. Do not substitute non-live v3 state 15 while its r15 identity is unverified; stills cannot establish collision and no numeric impact is inferred.

rows.subject: Team Tether stronghold
rows.defect: The stronghold reads as a small dark ruin behind dominant pylons on approach and as a broad sparsely dressed stone room up close
rows.review_disposition: Direct stronghold approach/detail High/Medium baseline FAIL all 4 pairs: pylons dominate the small dark landmark; interior reads sparse; rain/night flatten back-wall values. Two OFF source candidates now isolate separate hypotheses: measured approach-pylon lighting and an installed training Dummy beside the approach-room weapon stand. Neither has captured or blind-reviewed improvement.
rows.required_next_evidence: Matched High/Medium approach and detail captures for each candidate, then independent blind full-bar review. The training Dummy remains outside the x[-2.6,2.6] passage lane and 11 m Warden ring; no numeric score inferred.
